sourceText:
Awesome Whoopie Pies
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 12:57am

Ingredients




1/2 cup Crisco
1 cup sugar
1 egg
2 cups flour
1/2 cup cocoa
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon baking powder
1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda
1 cup milk
1 cup marshmallow
1 cup Crisco
1 cup confectioners sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla
Milk

Preparation

1 Beat Crisco, sugar and egg until creamy. (Phase 1). Mix flour, cocoa, salt, baking powder, baking soda and milk, combine with Phase 1 ingredients. Spoon little blobs onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 475 degrees for 7 minutes (or maybe a little less). 2 Beat until creamy, dilute with milk.
